items.title: Senate Democrat Probes Tether Payments to Ex-White House Crypto Adviser’s Firm
SEC Flags AI 'Super Intelligence' and Tokenization as Systemic Market Risks
items.summary: The regulator's Division of Examinations named "super intelligence and other advanced technologies" as a focus area alongside tokenization risks.

items.title: Bitcoin Core Rewrites Its Security Policy for a World Where AI Finds Bugs in One Prompt
items.summary: Developers will now backport fixes and cut releases immediately for flaws flagged as “easily discoverable,” abandoning long embargoes for bugs an attacker can surface with a single AI prompt.
